full_page.content:
1957, March 17
The following is a faithful transcription of a handwritten note on an envelope by the Servant of God, Rather Solens Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
(Handwriting of Mrs. Fellrath) Enclosed check for $20.00 for Msgr. Edward. (In Father Solanus' handwriting)
3/17/57
From Mrs. John Fellrath 20.00 - exchange - God bless Mrs. Fellrath. I surely hope her health will give Dr. favorable surprises. Fr. Solanus, Pardon Time
(On reverse side of envelope Father Solanus has written the following) 1957 March 17 - St. Patrick's - just as novices were leaving for Baraga - new novitiate - Sad news of Pres. Magsaysay's tragedy? came to us. ... We can hardly do better for him than pray for his cause, for him and for worthy successors - also for conversion of his unfortunate enemies. Fr. Solanus
